title: IHC Staining of Iba1 and Gfap Using DAB
author: Hanne HD Dhondt
materials: Streptavidin/HRP antibody (Agilent; P0397 OR Invitrogen; S911) is diluted 1:1000 in PBS-T. Example: 6.5 ml: 6.5 µl STR-HRP + 6500 µl PBS-T 0.1%

!! work in the hood during the whole DAB step!! Wear double gloves and an extra pair of covering sleeves. Take with you: 25 mL PBS pH 7.6 in a 50 ml falcon covered with aluminium foil. PBS-T to rinse 1 tablet of 10 mg 3,3'-Diaminobenzidine tetrahydrochloride (DAB) (Sigma; D5905; CAS: 7411-49-6) An Eppendorf tube with H 2 O 2 (you need 7 µl) 0.22 µm filter (Carl Roth; SE2M035I07) 10 ml syringe Plastic bag Extra prepared plates with the same label as the ones you are using now.

Cover with #1.5 cover slips (epredia; BB02400500SC13MNZ0) by using DPX (Sigma-Aldrich; 06522; CAS: 84-74-2). To put DPX use a Pasteur pipet as a “spoon” since the solution is very viscous. Let them dry Overnight in the hood.

!! work in the hood during the whole DAB step!! Wear double gloves and an extra pair of covering sleeves. Take with you: 25 mL PBS pH 7.6 in a 50 ml falcon covered with aluminium foil. PBS-T to rinse 1 tablet of 10 mg 3,3'-Diaminobenzidine tetrahydrochloride (DAB) (Sigma; D5905; CAS: 7411-49-6) An Eppendorf tube with H 2 O 2 (you need 7 µl) 0.22 µm filter (Carl Roth; SE2M035I07) 10 ml syringe Plastic bag Extra prepared plates with the same label as the ones you are using now.

steps.title: Add citrate buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 1 M citrate buffer (pH 6) to each well, making sure the tissue lies flat and is in full contact with the buffer.

steps.title: Heat retrieval
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 30 min at 80 °C, then place on ice for 20 min in the same citrate buffer.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of 3 % H₂O₂ (Chemlab; CL00.2306.1000) plus 10 % MeOH (VWR; 20846.361) in PBS. Add 500 µL per well and incubate 10 min at room temperature on a wobbler. Example preparation for 7 mL total: 5.6 mL PBS + 0.7 mL 30 % H₂O₂ + 0.7 mL 100 % MeOH.

steps.title: Wash with PBS‑T
steps.instruction: Add 1X PBS‑T containing 0.1 % Tergitol to each well, incubate 5 min on the wobbler. Repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well of primary antibody solution and incubate overnight at room temperature. For Iba1: dilute 1:500 (Abcam; Ab5076; RRID: AB_2224402) in PBS with 10 % rabbit serum (Agilent; X0902). For GFAP: dilute 1:2000 (Agilent; z0334; RRID: AB_10013382) in PBS with 10 % goat serum (Agilent; X0907).

steps.title: Secondary biotinylated antibody
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well of biotinylated secondary antibody and incubate 30 min at room temperature on the wobbler. For Iba1: rabbit anti‑goat biotinylated (Agilent; E0466) 1:600 in PBS‑T. For GFAP: goat anti‑rabbit biotinylated (Abcam; ab6720; RRID: AB_954902) 1:600 in PBS‑T.

steps.title: Add unspecified reagent
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well and incubate 30 min at room temperature on the wobbler. (Reagent not specified in the source text.)

steps.title: Prepare DAB solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve one DAB tablet in 25 mL PBS, cover the tube with aluminium foil. Filter the solution through a 0.22 µm filter using a 10 mL syringe, then add 7 µL H₂O₂.

steps.title: DAB development
steps.instruction: Remove PBS‑T from the wells, add 250 µL per well of the DAB solution, and develop at room temperature. For Iba1: allow a 6‑min reaction time starting with the first well. For GFAP: allow a 3‑min reaction time after all 24 wells have been pipetted.

steps.title: Transfer to fresh PBS
steps.instruction: Fill a new plate with PBS and move the sections from the original plate into the new PBS‑filled plate.

steps.title: Rinse with PBS/AD
steps.instruction: Rinse the sections in a petri dish with a 1:1 mixture of PBS and AD (½ PBS + ½ AD).

steps.title: Dehydrate and clear
steps.instruction: Sequentially immerse sections for 5 min each in 70 % EtOH (Fisher Scientific; E/0650DF/08; CAS 64‑17‑5), 90 % EtOH, 100 % EtOH, a second 5 min in 100 % EtOH, and finally 5 min in Histoclear II (Agar Scientific; A2‑0105).

steps.title: Mount and dry
steps.instruction: Mount sections on pork gelatin‑coated glass slides and let them dry overnight.

steps.title: Image slides
steps.instruction: Visualise the slides using a Leica Aperio CS2 slide scanner at 20× magnification.
